name: design-director
description: Catch a screen that looks generic before you call the work done, and keep every design score on record. A critic scores each screenshot without seeing the code, so the agent that built the screen is not the one grading it. Three tiers run from a single-call spot check after any UI change to a full redesign with seeded directions and critic rounds. Critic runs spend tokens on your own provider account, at a cost that depends on the model you pick, and the screenshot scripts need Chrome or Chromium and Node 18 or newer.
